info.title: ScrapingDog Universal API
info.description: ScrapingDog helps agents scrape webpages, search SERPs, and extract structured results across Google, Maps, News, Scholar, Amazon, YouTube, and other supported search surfaces.

get.description: Retrieves account details from ScrapingDog.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

concurrencyLimit.description: Maximum concurrent requests allowed on the account.

linkedinConcurrencyLimit.description: Separate concurrency limit returned for LinkedIn-related requests.

linkedinThreadCount.description: Current LinkedIn thread count returned by the account endpoint.

packType.description: Billing cadence or plan type for the current package.

requestLimit.description: Total request quota available for the current billing window.

requestUsed.description: Number of requests already consumed in the current billing window.

threadCount.description: Number of active threads currently in use.

validity.description: Remaining validity value returned by the account endpoint.
